authorization_lineage.b8_purpose: Freeze the only permitted final Stage B architecture before any Stage B outcome analysis.

bootstrap_contract.primary: Resample the fixed cohort within each class using the exact Stage B bootstrap implementation frozen in the execution workflow; preserve class size 48 and report excess-class-variance ratio.

cohort_contract.selection: For each NFL Draft year 2010-2023, sort all NFL-drafted QB/RB/WR/TE players by overall NFL draft pick ascending and freeze the first 48.

finality_policy.if_stage_b_fails: Close Draft Class Strength V1 at neutral multiplier 1.00. No additional target, null, metric, class-window, or subgroup may be tried on 2010-2023 to rescue V1.
finality_policy.if_stage_b_passes: Authorize predictor-source feasibility only. Do not deploy or score 2027.

forbidden: fit predictor models before Stage B primary verdict
change H3.O2 after seeing Stage B
change the 48-player cohort after seeing Stage B
replace unresolved players with player 49 or later
change the rank-stratified null after seeing Stage B
change primary thresholds after seeing Stage B
promote any non-gating diagnostic to primary after results
use KTC or fantasy rookie ADP to fit fundamental class talent
run another rescue target/null on 2010-2023 if Stage B fails
frozen_after_b8: power grid and 2000 simulations per point

missing_outcome_contract.primary_if_unresolved_remain: Assign the frozen H3.O2 zero/floor outcome implied by the existing function; do not hand-select a value.
resolution_sequence: 1. Resolve stable identity using approved identity-only sources.
2. Determine whether seasons 1-3 contain qualifying NFL production using the frozen provider.
3. Verified zero qualifying production receives exactly the value returned by the frozen H3.O2 function for zero qualifying production.
4. A player with qualifying production but unresolved identity is UNRESOLVED and must undergo manual identity review.
missing_outcome_contract.sensitivity_if_unresolved_remain: Assign the median H3.O2 among resolved players in the same position and frozen skill-pick rank bin: 1-6, 7-12, 13-24, 25-48.

items: outcome-sorted top48 of a fixed first72 drafted-skill cohort
uncapped three-year VORP-style alternative outcome metric
position x broad skill-pick-rank-bin permutation using bins 1-6, 7-12, 13-24, 25-48

power_contract.pass_definition: meets all three primary Stage B signal gates
power_contract.purpose: Determine whether a Stage B failure had adequate power to detect economically meaningful class-level effects.

primary_null_contract.definition: For each skill-position pick rank k=1..48 independently, permute the 14 observed H3.O2 values across the 14 draft classes. Reconstruct each class total and leave-one-out class_log_strength after all 48 ranks are permuted.
primary_null_contract.destroys: association between draft class and realized H3.O2 conditional on skill-pick rank
primary_null_contract.name: skill_pick_rank_stratified_permutation
primary_null_contract.p_value: (1 + number of permuted variances >= observed variance) / 50001
preserves: each skill-pick rank's empirical H3.O2 distribution
every class's one observation at each skill-pick rank

registry_identity_contract.equivalence_failure_action: Fix identity/plumbing only. H3.O2 constants may not change.

target_contract.class_log_strength: log(class total / arithmetic mean of all other eligible class totals)
target_contract.class_total: sum of H3.O2 for all fixed 48 cohort players
